name: Central Sikhote-Alin
story: Central Sikhote-Alin is a forest region in Primorsky Krai, Russia. Founded on February 10, 1935, the zapovednik covers 401,428 ha. It protects a population of the sable and the endangered Siberian tiger.
matters: The region is placed on the World Heritage List for its importance to the survival of endangered species such as the Amur tiger.
